'''Ossus Stone Guardians''', also known as '''Jedi defense droids''', were a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] disguised as minimalist statues popular in the Jedi temples constructed around the time of the [[Qel-Droma Epics/Legends|Qel-Droma Epics]].

==Description==
These simple droids could remain still for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] without maintenance, moving only when their [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] detected a threat. The powerful juggernauts would then attack all targets within their assigned area. Operating under the most basic of programming, most were unable to distinguish between friend and foe. The droids were heavily armored and, in some cases, layers of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] lined the droid chassis beneath their heavy stone exteriors. Still, the droids had a built-in weakness&mdash;[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who thought to do so could use [[the Force]] to move a shutdown switch located within a droid's torso.<ref name="Nexus of Power" />

==History==
[[File:ChamberOfAntiquities.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ossus Stone Guardians in the Chamber of Antiquities at the Great Jedi Library.]]
By the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], two stone guardians were present in the round office of [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] during the continued [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] of [[Nomi Sunrider]], as she was learning more about the [[Battle meditation/Legends|Battle meditation]] and [[Sever Force/Legends|Sever Force]], in the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]] at the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="Sith War 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref>

As Nomi departed,<ref name="Sith War 1" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] violated the Chamber of Antiquities and assaulted and murdered Odan-Urr before stealing the [[Dark Holocron]] from him and leaving his corpse to rot.<ref name="PotJ">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> The Ossus Stone Guardians were unable to prevent his death, as they never activated.<ref name="Sith War 1" />

By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], they were guarding the [[Neer's Gauntlet/Legends|Neer's Gauntlet]] and the [[Greelwood Saber/Legends|Greelwood Saber]] in the [[Vault of Justice]] at the Great Jedi Library. Also in the Chamber of Antiquities, a [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]] skeleton still remained sprawled at the feet of his great chair in his office, while two stone guardians stood as silent sentinels to protect the chamber from intruders.<ref name="Nexus of Power" />
